{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A wool-blend blazer in deep charcoal (#2F4F4F), tailored to a structured single-breasted cut with notched lapels and hip length.
Worn over a fine-gauge merino knit top in midnight blue (#191970) featuring a soft crew neck and ribbed cuffs, falling to mid-hip for ease of movement.
Paired with dark wash denim trousers (#273A4B), cut straight-leg with a relaxed rise to prevent constriction during the twenty-minute walk.
Footed in waterproof leather ankle boots in forest green (#2E581D) with a low stacked heel, offering traction against salted cobblestones and melting snow.
Accessorized with a sleek silver-tone watch and a compact, insulated tote bag in matte black leather to protect contents from the frost.
This outfit works because it balances professional polish with practical warmth for a freezing, snowy commute. The structured blazer elevates the casual denim to meet office expectations while the thick wools and waterproof boots ensure comfort against the minus-ten temperature. Every piece chosen allows for easy walking on slippery cobblestones without sacrificing style or violating her request for work-appropriate attire."}
